options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: authentication_mechanism
options.description: The authentication mechanism to use for the SMTP connection.

options.name: fromaddress
options.description: The email address to use as the "From" address in notifications.

options.name: ipaddress
options.description: The IP address or hostname of the SMTP server.

options.name: notifyemailaddress
options.description: The email address to send notifications to.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for SMTP authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the SMTP server. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: ssl
options.description: Enables or disables SSL/TLS for the SMTP connection.

options.name: sslvalidate
options.description: Enables or disables SSL/TLS certificate validation for the SMTP connection.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout (in seconds) for the SMTP connection.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for SMTP authentication.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
